title: Tool salience lives in CLAUDE.md, not tool descriptions
body: Benchmark A/B runs (2026-07): with only MCP tool descriptions — even CALL-THIS-FIRST phrasing — assistants made zero Mason calls in 24 sessions; with the marker-delimited CLAUDE.md section, adoption went to 4/6 with correct per-tool routing. Empirical hierarchy: project instructions > tool descriptions > tool availability. Any new tool must be added to CLAUDE_MD_SECTION, not just registered; never evaluate a tool's value without checking the benchmark's mason-calls column first.
